title.en: What the Pipe (fluid conveyance) outline cannot add to concrete pump integral piston φ200
title.zh: 《Pipe (fluid conveyance)》的大纲不能给concrete pump integral piston φ200加数字

description.en: Section titles come from Pipe (fluid conveyance); the concrete pump integral piston φ200 figures stay the printed ones. A φ200 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ200 as its piston.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Pipe (fluid conveyance)》，concrete pump integral piston φ200的数字仍是已印数字。φ200 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ200 写成自己的活塞。

h1.en: Pipe (fluid conveyance) headings over the concrete pump integral piston φ200 catalogue line
h1.zh: 《Pipe (fluid conveyance)》的标题盖在concrete pump integral piston φ200的目录行上

directAnswer.en: The short answer for concrete pump integral piston φ200 uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Pipe (fluid conveyance) is the outline those cells are filed under. A φ200 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ200 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ200的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《Pipe (fluid conveyance)》是这些格子所依的大纲。 φ200 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ200 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: Use “Uses” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ200. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The split-piston page also lists φ200, with its own material row and a set as the unit. Same outer diameter does not merge the two parts. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 用“用途”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ200。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。分体活塞页也有 φ200，那边有自己的材料行，单位是套。外径相同也不会把两件配件并成一件。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “History” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ200, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “历史”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ200 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Manufacture”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. A φ200 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ200 as its piston. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“制造”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 φ200 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ200 写成自己的活塞。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Sizes” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Sizes”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 大纲补不上空白格子。
